checks.label: Content-Security-Policy
checks.source: CSP Level 3, 'Directives' (script-src, style-src and object-src fall back to default-src; base-uri and frame-ancestors have no fallback), 'Does a source list allow all inline behavior for type?' ('unsafe-inline' is ignored next to a nonce or hash), 'Policy lists' (every policy is enforced); Google CSP Evaluator
checks.applicability: Applies to responses with at least one enforced Content-Security-Policy header; without one (or with only a report-only policy) there is no policy to judge.
checks.expectation: Fails when any directive's source list contains a wildcard host. Without an enforced CSP the check does not apply (that is the missing_header finding).

response_headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://*.cdn.example; img-src *; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
